quote: After collecting the win rates for each paragraph, we look to explain why models pick some paragraphs over others. We first compute several automatic metrics and correlate them with the win-rate: • Readability: We use the Flesch-Kincaid readability test. • Number of unique tokens: We measure the number of unique lemmas in the text. • Binary sentiment: We measure the probability of positive sentiment using the FLAN-large model. • Perplexity: We measure this using the GPT-2 medium model. • n-gram overlap: We measure the maximum length n-gram that is common to the question and paragraph. • Question embedding similarity: We use TAS-B to measure the relevance of the question to the paragraph.
